text: Before instructing the user to check their payment requests, the conversation must show the agent already sent a payment request.
applies_when: The agent's message instructs the user to check or look at their payment requests.

text: Before instructing the user to lift a line suspension, the conversation must show the agent checked the line's contract end date (and it is not in the past).
applies_when: The agent's message instructs the user to lift or remove a line suspension.

text: Before instructing the user to change their plan, the conversation must show the agent confirmed which line the change applies to.
applies_when: The agent's message instructs the user to change their plan.

text: Before instructing the user to enable data roaming, the conversation must show the agent had the user check the line's roaming-enabled status.
applies_when: The agent's message instructs the user to enable data roaming.

text: Before instructing the user to reset APN settings, the conversation must show the agent had the user check the current APN settings.
applies_when: The agent's message instructs the user to reset or change APN settings.

text: Before instructing the user to grant app permissions, the conversation must show the agent had the user check the current app permissions.
applies_when: The agent's message instructs the user to grant or enable app permissions.
